# NanoDet front-camera weights

`object_detection_nanodet_2022nov.onnx` is the unmodified FP32 NanoDet-m-plus-1.5x_416
COCO object detector distributed by OpenCV Zoo. The upstream model directory
licenses all of its files under Apache 2.0. A copy is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

- [Model and upstream license statement](https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/48b10fa505aeb51fbd127fc60a5c660040e823b7/models/object_detection_nanodet)
- [Pinned Git LFS pointer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/48b10fa505aeb51fbd127fc60a5c660040e823b7/models/object_detection_nanodet/object_detection_nanodet_2022nov.onnx)
- [Original model download](https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/opencv/opencv_zoo/48b10fa505aeb51fbd127fc60a5c660040e823b7/models/object_detection_nanodet/object_detection_nanodet_2022nov.onnx)

The model is 3,800,954 bytes. Its SHA-256 digest is
`4b82da9944b88577175ee23a459dce2e26e6e4be573def65b1055dc2d9720186`.
Inference uses the local file and the OpenCV CPU backend.
